name: All Saints Church

layers.essential_history: [[c:Work on the stone chancel arch of All Saints began in 1270. Inside are two Saxon crosses, found buried north of the chancel during repairs in 1885 and 1886.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The crosses were moved inside the church in 2022 to protect them. Parish records here go back to 1279.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Inside All Saints, the clerk shows you where Mistress Carey knelt. She explains the coded scrap from the stable: she wrote it for herself, to remember where she saw the officer take the casket.]]

sources.title: Elton Parish Council: A short history of Elton

directions_to_next: [[c:Take the path north from the church to School Lane, about 190 metres.]]
evidence: [[c:Mistress Carey saw the casket taken to the ford and wrote it down in code.]]
